newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Multidana rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Multidana rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesian consumer finance company PT Putra Surya Multidana rose in active trading on its debut on Monday on expected strong growth, brokers said.
Shares of Multidana rose to 2,450 rupiah, compared with its offer price of 2,175 rupiah, at mid-morning. Volume was about 27.9 million shares.
"This is slightly above our expectations. Response from investors, particularly local buyers, is quite strong," a broker with local firm said.
Brokers attributed the encouraging listing of Multidana to its fundamentals and expected strong prospects for the consumer financing business in Indonesia.
Another broker from a domestic securities firm expected its share price to hover around the 2,350 to 2,400 rupiah level on good buying interest.
PT Putra Surya Multidana floated 250 million shares, with PT Peregrine Sewu Securities acting as lead manager.
